# bigData example: a Settings checkbox toggles the header column menus

## Context

Header menus, cornerstone 2 of 13.3 (#19643), shipped opt-in: `columnMenu: true` on a grid, overridable per column. No shipped page turns it on. `grep -rn columnMenu examples/ apps/` at `d2014f4433` finds nothing; the cornerstone's e2e specs flip it at runtime through the Neural Link. So the 13.3 release notes (#19748) can only tell readers to set the flag themselves, and the notes' next iteration has no page on which to capture the header-menu screenshot that #19712 names. The steward of #19643 agreed with this shape (A2A, 2026-10-15).

## The Problem

A reader cannot see the 13.3 header menus without writing code, and the release has no demo for its second cornerstone. `examples/grid/bigData` is the natural stage: its 100k store is the population the menu's counting filter was measured on.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/grid/bigData/ControlsContainer.mjs` holds the Settings tab. Its controls reach the grid through `get grid()` (`this.parent.getItem('grid')`) and set grid configs in `up.*` handlers. `onConstructed()` already reads `me.grid`.
- `examples/grid/bigData/GridContainer.mjs` extends `Neo.grid.Container`, whose `columnMenu_` (default `false`) passes a change on to the header buttons in `afterSetColumnMenu`. It fires no event.
- Precedent: `examples/grid/cellEditing/MainContainer.mjs` sets a CheckBox's `checked` from the component it controls (`checked: me.exampleComponent.dragResortable`).

## The Fix

- Settings tab: a `CheckBox` labelled "Column menus". Its change handler sets `grid.columnMenu`.
- The checkbox takes its state from `grid.columnMenu` in `onConstructed()`, never a hardcoded default.
- The example's `GridContainer` fires `columnMenuChange` from `afterSetColumnMenu`. `ControlsContainer` listens and updates the checkbox, so a direct flip of the grid, for example through the Neural Link, moves the checkbox too.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: In `examples/grid/bigData`, ticking "Column menus" turns the header menus on and unticking turns them off (`grid.columnMenu` and the header buttons follow). e2e-tested.
- [ ] AC-2: The checkbox starts at the grid's `columnMenu` value, and a direct change to `grid.columnMenu` updates it. e2e-tested.
- [ ] AC-3: With the box unticked, the example's headers behave as before; the default stays off.

## Out of Scope

- The release-notes screenshot itself (#19712's next iteration).
- Engine changes to `Neo.grid.Container`.
- A dedicated header-menu example.

## Related
